unsupported_statements: "This requester was previously denied access to this resource last year." The facts contain no request history or prior denial.
"The model scores it at the 85th percentile for likely denial." The facts give a risk_score_percentile of 85. They don't say it measures likelihood of denial.

"48 of 136 resource requests come from the 659 dept requests" garbles the numbers. The facts give 48 dept-resource requests, 136 resource requests and 659 department requests. They don't say the 48 are a share of the 136 that come from the 659.
"have the resource owner review the request" refers to a resource owner role. The facts don't mention one, although this is a recommendation.
